sql: with lp as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, side, quantity from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select 1 as sec, to_char(o.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') a, coalesce(o.strategy,'?') b, o.market_ticker c, coalesce(o.side,'') d, coalesce(o.status,'') e from live_orders o where o.strategy ilike '%limm%' and o.created_at > now() - interval '5 days' union all select 2, to_char(lp.captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'pos', lp.market_ticker, coalesce(lp.side,'')||' '||coalesce(lp.quantity::text,''), '' from lp where lp.market_ticker like 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE%' and coalesce(lp.quantity,0) <> 0 union all select 3, to_char(b.at,'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'ledger', b.balance_cents::text||'c res='||coalesce(b.residual_cents::text,'-'), 'f='||coalesce(b.fills_counted::text,'-')||' s='||coalesce(b.settlements_counted::text,'-'), coalesce(b.notes_json::text,'null') from incentive_balance_observations b where b.at > now() - interval '2.5 hours' order by 1, 2 desc limit 30
